name_en: Nasi ayam hainan panggang (roasted chicken rice)
intro: A plate of roasted Hainanese chicken rice is about 600 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the chicken-oil rice and the roasted chicken with skin.

breakdown.part: Chicken rice (cooked in chicken oil), 1 cup
Chilli sauce, thick soy sauce, ginger

variants.name: Plain white rice instead of chicken rice

diet: Yes, it's one of the lighter rice options when eating out. The chicken gives you high protein and the portion is easy to control. The chicken-oil rice is what adds calories, so switch to white rice if the shop has it. With a few small changes, you can eat this regularly while dieting.
tips: Ask for plain white rice instead of chicken rice if available.
Remove the chicken skin or choose the breast.
Add blanched sawi or taugeh as a side.

swap.name: Steamed chicken breast + white rice + blanched vegetables
swap.why: Less oil from the rice and skin, but still high in protein and filling.

faq.q: What's the difference between roasted and steamed chicken in chicken rice?
faq.a: Roasted chicken is grilled or roasted with a sweet sauce, so the skin is darker. Steamed chicken is slowly poached and softer.

faq.q: Why is chicken rice so oily and fragrant?
faq.a: The rice is cooked with chicken stock, chicken oil, ginger and garlic.

faq.q: Is chicken rice chilli sauce high in calories?
faq.a: Not really. The chilli-ginger sauce is usually light. Thick soy sauce has sugar though, so use just enough.
